verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a SaaS robotics platform could let users opt out of vendor usage analytics, but the pack has no evidence of any such opt-out. The cited controls (choosing which data streams upload to the cloud, rate limits, low-bandwidth mode) govern the customer's own robot telemetry ingestion. That is an adjacent feature, not an opt-out from the vendor's telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
